name: Gagnoa
source: Côte d'Ivoire Ministry of Construction, Housing and Urban Development SIGFU, with official DGI/OPF evidence of a Gagnoa decentralized Cadastre service

queries.query: Gagnoa Côte d'Ivoire cadastral parcel map official land registry geospatial service
queries.result: Found the official SIGFU public portal describing lotissements, lots and cartography, and official government evidence naming Gagnoa in the decentralized Cadastre network. No public anonymous parcel feature endpoint or downloadable geometry was verified.

queries.query: Gagnoa Côte d'Ivoire cadastre parcelles carte officielle service foncier
queries.result: French-language first-party discovery found the official SIGFU parcel/lot/cartography portal, Ministry service guidance directing users to SIGFU for lot and lotissement status, and official cadastre-directory evidence. No public schema/CRS response or safe parcel geometry was identified.
